historic_grid.label: Before Endless Museum
historic_grid.reason: Parent of the first commit adding commons/scenes/endless_museum.gd. Later Museum-era edits changed the source Grid layouts, so current map_data.json is a separate edition.
historic_grid.scope: Versioned Grid maps, code, artifact scenes and assets from this exact commit; exported in an isolated snapshot using Godot 4.6 and a current geometry-extraction adapter. Unversioned support dependencies and any required material substitutes are recorded separately. Not a claim of pixel-identical historical rendering or that every current spine map existed at this date.
